newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli military lorries move out of Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israeli military lorries move out of Hebron.

text.p: The Israeli army moved military trucks out of Hebron and began dismantling a checkpoint ahead of a handover of most of the West Bank town to Palestinian rule, witnesses said on Thursday.
The government approved a deal to give Palestinians self-rule in Hebron but officials said the handover would not take place before a parliamentary vote expected later on Thursday.

Witnesses said seven military semitrailers were seen driving out of the town. "They are taking the last containers out of the military headquarters and taking away military checkpoints," a witness said.
An army spokeswoman said she was checking the report.
Under the deal with the Palestinians Israel is to pull out of 80 percent of the town where some 400 Jews live and study amid 100,000 Arabs.
Parliament was expected to approve the deal after a debate on Thursday.
